reported_observations.demonstration: A guest picked a flavor and Derek dispensed it, with one valve temporarily replaced by an elbow fitting to make it work. The guest said it tasted like Mug root beer.
reported_observations.cause: Derek had read a valve's flow arrow backwards and had the pumps mixed up. Flavor B's line carried flavor A's valve, so flavor B did not pump. Flavor A's valve was fitted backwards, so flavor A poured.

quotes: Successful demo ... of her picking a flavor and me dispensing it not too much later, but I did have to replace a valve with an elbow joint to make it work.

All issues resolved. I had indeed read an arrow backwards, and so had not realized that I had the flavor B valve on the flavor A pump and this explains why no pumping was occurring - essentially I had the pumps mixed up, and subsequently everything else.
So flavor B was not working, but it was because it had flavor A's valve, and flavor A was working, but it was because it had a backwards valve

diagnosis.reported: Across the two unplugged loom leads of the valve the elbow had replaced, on the AstroAI DM6000AR's DC-volts setting, the reading stayed between 2 and 3 whether or not Prime B was held.
diagnosis.interpretation: An off TBD62083 output leaks through the meter's 10 MΩ input and reads a few volts against the 12 V lead; an output Prime switches on reads about 12 V. The valve's switched lead sat on an output Prime B does not turn on, which fits flavor B's line carrying flavor A's valve.

diagnosis.reported: The arrow was read backwards on one valve.
diagnosis.interpretation: The Beduan listing (B07NWCQJK9) gives a working pressure of 0.02–0.8 MPa and warns that reverse installation leaves the valve open and unable to close. A reversed valve passes flow under its pump's pressure whether or not it is switched, which fits flavor A pouring.

firmware.installed_build: 2026.10.18 eee1362e2+, read back on the main board's console after it was flashed.
firmware.valve_plan: Prime and the pour on flavor A open V-E and V-G (MANIFOLD A OUT5 and OUT7); on flavor B, V-H and V-J (MANIFOLD A OUT8 and MANIFOLD B OUT2).
firmware.investigation_build: e46c94c1c drove every J1 and J2 output on any Prime or pour while the wiring was in question; eee1362e2 reverted it.

article_identity.valves: Beduan 12 V 1/4 in normally closed solenoid valve, B07NWCQJK9; coil label DC12V, 4.8 W.
article_identity.scope: The report does not name the valve positions, pump heads or loom cavities involved, or the corrected arrangement.

qualification_limits: Derek reports all issues resolved. No post-correction measurement is recorded: no coil resistance, no 12 V reading under Prime, no flow rate or ratio.
Whether the valve the elbow replaced has been restored is not stated.
The unit of the 2–3 reading was not reported. Its interpretation as volts from an off driver output is the diagnosing session's, made before Derek's finding and consistent with it.
Fill, Clean and Dry operation remain unreported, as in the soda-service observation.
The guest's comparison is one impression, not a blind or side-by-side taste test.
This record does not establish leakage, the pressure across any valve or its margin to the listed 0.02 MPa minimum, safety qualification or endurance.
